## Change

Describe the user-visible result and the implementation needed to review it. Group larger changes by module. Explain a design choice when it affects use or maintenance.

## Validation

List each check once with its environment, result and coverage. For UI changes, include browser interactions and error-log inspection. For performance results, include the measured workload.

- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation were updated together, or this change does not affect documentation.
- [ ] Documentation structure checks passed, and paired text was reviewed for matching meaning.

## Compatibility and follow-up

Include this section when the change requires migration, has a known issue, or needs a specific follow-up check. State the affected behavior and next action.
